summary: The change adds Strict-Transport-Security with max-age=31536000 for HTTPS requests whose hostname matches the configured canonical issuer, applying it to normal responses, CORS-wrapped responses, identity-unavailable 503s, internal 500s, and Worker-level fallbacks. It does not add includeSubDomains or preload, and it leaves HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect behavior unchanged.

evidence: src/http.ts:16-43 defines max-age=31536000 and adds the HSTS header only for HTTPS requests whose request-derived hostname matches the configured canonical issuer.
src/passport.ts:2694-2714 wraps the auth-identity 503, normal route success, and internal 500 responses after CORS handling.
src/worker.ts:119 wraps Worker-level fallback responses so canonical HTTPS error responses also receive the header.
No includeSubDomains or preload was added, and the existing HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect contract was not modified.
